description: Overview Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 is an AI Agent hackathon bringing together students, developers, builders, and AI enthusiasts from across India to explore the future of Agentic AI and build real-world AI Agent solutions. Join WhatsApp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/FAgowp2Sd4PApaXr6jqQyL What You’ll Experience Explore AI Agents & Agentic AI - Understand how AI is moving beyond simple chatbots toward systems that can reason, interact, coordinate, and take action. Build with ASI: One - Get hands-on experience with ASI:One and its ecosystem while building your solution. Work on a Real-World Challenge - Take an idea from concept to a working AI Agent and solve a meaningful real-world problem. Hands-on Building - Spend the day designing, developing, testing, and improving your AI Agent with your team. Mentor Support - Get guidance and feedback from mentors and the ASI:One team throughout the building process. Meet Fellow Builders - Connect with students, developers, AI enthusiasts, and builders who are exploring the future of Agentic AI. Build & Submit Your Project - Complete your solution and submit your project for evaluation. Closing & Next Steps - Wrap up the event, celebrate the builders, and learn about what comes next. The final results of Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 will be announced on 28 October 2026 . Who Should Attend? Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 is for: Students and college developers Software developers AI/ML enthusiasts AI Agent builders Startup founders and innovators Open-source contributors Anyone interested in Agentic AI You don't need to be an AI expert to participate. Bring your idea, curiosity, and willingness to build — and get ready to experience the future of AI Agents. Learn. Build. Collaborate. Create. Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 — where builders come together to build the next generation of AI Agents powered by ASI:One.

Overview

Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 is an AI Agent hackathon bringing together students, developers, builders, and AI enthusiasts from across India to explore the future of Agentic AI and build real-world AI Agent solutions.

Join WhatsApp Group:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/FAgowp2Sd4PApaXr6jqQyL

What You’ll Experience

  • Explore AI Agents & Agentic AI - Understand how AI is moving beyond simple chatbots toward systems that can reason, interact, coordinate, and take action.
  • Build with ASI: One - Get hands-on experience with ASI:One and its ecosystem while building your solution.
  • Work on a Real-World Challenge - Take an idea from concept to a working AI Agent and solve a meaningful real-world problem.
  • Hands-on Building - Spend the day designing, developing, testing, and improving your AI Agent with your team.
  • Mentor Support - Get guidance and feedback from mentors and the ASI:One team throughout the building process.
  • Meet Fellow Builders - Connect with students, developers, AI enthusiasts, and builders who are exploring the future of Agentic AI.
  • Build & Submit Your Project - Complete your solution and submit your project for evaluation.
  • Closing & Next Steps - Wrap up the event, celebrate the builders, and learn about what comes next.
  • The final results of Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 will be announced on 28 October 2026.

Who Should Attend?

Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 is for:

  • Students and college developers
  • Software developers
  • AI/ML enthusiasts
  • AI Agent builders
  • Startup founders and innovators
  • Open-source contributors
  • Anyone interested in Agentic AI

You don't need to be an AI expert to participate. Bring your idea, curiosity, and willingness to build — and get ready to experience the future of AI Agents.

Learn. Build. Collaborate. Create.

Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 — where builders come together to build the next generation of AI Agents powered by ASI:One.
